UserMessage(content=[ToolResultBlock(tool_use_id='toolu_01Q9ZKJsTf5LmeV5zpmYS4ND', content='<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>\n<resources>\n    <string name="intro_slide1_title">Let\\\'s get started</string>\n    <string name="intro_slide1_desc">Welcome to <b>andOTP</b>, this wizard will guide you through\n        the initial setup. Please pay attention and read carefully otherwise you could lose data!\n        \\n\\nDon\\\'t worry, you can still change any of the options later in the <b>Settings</b>.</string>\n\n    <string name="intro_slide2_desc">To ensure the security of your accounts <b>andOTP</b> only\n        stores them in encrypted data files. Here you can choose which method of encryption will be\n        used.</string>\n    <string name="intro_slide2_desc_keystore">The KeyStore is a system component of Android for\n        securely storing cryptographic keys. The advantage of this method is that the keys are\n        stored separated from the data files and can be backed by hardware cryptography (if your\n        device supports it). However, as the keys are not stored with the apps data, <b>this method\n        prevents external backup solutions (like Titanium) from working</b>. If you choose this\n        method you will have to rely on the internal backup functions provided by <b>andOTP</b>.\n        \\n\\n<b>Warning</b>: The KeyStore is known to cause a lot of problems, please only use it if\n        you absolutely have to. If you don\\\'t mind entering a password / PIN every time you start\n        <b>andOTP</b> it is <b>highly recommended to use the password-based encryption instead</b>.</string>\n    <string name="intro_slide2_desc_password">This method will encrypt your data with a key\n        generated from a password or PIN. The main advantage here is that this will work with\n        external backup solutions (like Titanium) and is much less failure-prone than the KeyStore.\n        However, you will have to enter your credentials every time you start <b>andOTP</b>.</string>\n\n    <string name="intro_slide3_desc_keystore">Here you can setup an authentication to lock\n        <b>andOTP</b>. Since you have chosen <b>Android KeyStore</b> as encryption method this is\n        optional.</string>\n    <string name="intro_slide3_desc_password">Here you can setup an authentication to lock\n        <b>andOTP</b>. Since you have chosen <b>Password / PIN</b> as encryption method you need to\n        set either a password or a PIN to proceed.</string>\n    <string name="intro_slide3_warn_no_password">Please set a password to continue!</string>\n    <string name="intro_slide3_warn_no_pin">Please set a PIN to continue!</string>\n    <string name="intro_slide3_warn_confirm_password">Please confirm your password to continue!</string>\n    <string name="intro_slide3_warn_confirm_pin">Please confirm your PIN to continue!</string>\n\n    <string name="intro_slide4_title">Finished</string>\n    <string name="intro_slide4_desc">Your settings have been saved, you are all set to use\n        <b>andOTP</b> now!</string>\n</resources>=== arrays ===\naboutlibraries_definitions.xml\ncolors.xml\ndimens.xml\nic_launcher_background.xml\nsettings.xml\nstrings_about.xml\nstrings_auth.xml\nstrings_backup.xml\nstrings_intro.xml\nstrings_main.xml\nstrings_settings.xml\nstyles.xml', is_error=False)], uuid='48687ddd-c38d-417e-b52a-2176224264d4', parent_tool_use_id=None, tool_use_result={'stdout': '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>\n<resources>\n    <string name="intro_slide1_title">Let\\\'s get started</string>\n    <string name="intro_slide1_desc">Welcome to <b>andOTP</b>, this wizard will guide you through\n        the initial setup. Please pay attention and read carefully otherwise you could lose data!\n        \\n\\nDon\\\'t worry, you can still change any of the options later in the <b>Settings</b>.</string>\n\n    <string name="intro_slide2_desc">To ensure the security of your accounts <b>andOTP</b> only\n        stores them in encrypted data files. Here you can choose which method of encryption will be\n        used.</string>\n    <string name="intro_slide2_desc_keystore">The KeyStore is a system component of Android for\n        securely storing cryptographic keys. The advantage of this method is that the keys are\n        stored separated from the data files and can be backed by hardware cryptography (if your\n        device supports it). However, as the keys are not stored with the apps data, <b>this method\n        prevents external backup solutions (like Titanium) from working</b>. If you choose this\n        method you will have to rely on the internal backup functions provided by <b>andOTP</b>.\n        \\n\\n<b>Warning</b>: The KeyStore is known to cause a lot of problems, please only use it if\n        you absolutely have to. If you don\\\'t mind entering a password / PIN every time you start\n        <b>andOTP</b> it is <b>highly recommended to use the password-based encryption instead</b>.</string>\n    <string name="intro_slide2_desc_password">This method will encrypt your data with a key\n        generated from a password or PIN. The main advantage here is that this will work with\n        external backup solutions (like Titanium) and is much less failure-prone than the KeyStore.\n        However, you will have to enter your credentials every time you start <b>andOTP</b>.</string>\n\n    <string name="intro_slide3_desc_keystore">Here you can setup an authentication to lock\n        <b>andOTP</b>. Since you have chosen <b>Android KeyStore</b> as encryption method this is\n        optional.</string>\n    <string name="intro_slide3_desc_password">Here you can setup an authentication to lock\n        <b>andOTP</b>. Since you have chosen <b>Password / PIN</b> as encryption method you need to\n        set either a password or a PIN to proceed.</string>\n    <string name="intro_slide3_warn_no_password">Please set a password to continue!</string>\n    <string name="intro_slide3_warn_no_pin">Please set a PIN to continue!</string>\n    <string name="intro_slide3_warn_confirm_password">Please confirm your password to continue!</string>\n    <string name="intro_slide3_warn_confirm_pin">Please confirm your PIN to continue!</string>\n\n    <string name="intro_slide4_title">Finished</string>\n    <string name="intro_slide4_desc">Your settings have been saved, you are all set to use\n        <b>andOTP</b> now!</string>\n</resources>=== arrays ===\naboutlibraries_definitions.xml\ncolors.xml\ndimens.xml\nic_launcher_background.xml\nsettings.xml\nstrings_about.xml\nstrings_auth.xml\nstrings_backup.xml\nstrings_intro.xml\nstrings_main.xml\nstrings_settings.xml\nstyles.xml', 'stderr': '', 'interrupted': False, 'isImage': False, 'noOutputExpected': False})

UserMessage(content=[ToolResultBlock(tool_use_id='toolu_01WkrKRF5KF75uA4wMkscbp1', content='# Changelog\n\n#### v0.6.3.1\n\n * Introduce build flavors:\n   - fdroid: Shows donation links in the About section\n   - play: Doesn\'t show donation links in the About section\n\n#### v0.6.3\n\n * Security: Improved password derivation for the password protected backups\n * New feature: Prevent of "QR code" (PR #368 by @yegortimoshenko)\n * Bug fix: Always use arabic numerals for the tokens (Issue #359)\n * Bug fix: Refactor storage access code to allow importing and exporting from cloud storage directly\n * Bug fix: Hardcode the black background color to avoid strange behaviour on some custom ROMs\n * Bug fix: Force English locales for saving AuthMethod\n * Misc: Update donation links (PR #351)\n * Thumbnails: Lots of new thumbnails\n * Translations: Hungarian\n\n#### v0.6.2\n\n * Bug fix: Proper handling of RTL layouts by forcing LTR for the tokens (PR #280 by @ahangarha)\n * Internal: Image compression (thanks to @Peppernrino)\n * Thumbnail: Add a LOT of new thumbnails (thanks to everybody that contributed)\n * Translation: New Arabic, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Persian and Swedish translations (thanks to all contributors on Crowdin)\n\n#### v0.6.1\n\n * New feature: Enable Android Backup by default if available and using the password encryption (PR #252)\n * Bug fix: Fix crash in the manual entry dialog on KitKat\n * Bug fix: Fix thumbnail generation on KitKat\n * Thumbnail: Add MediaWiki (PR #246 by @MeLlamoPablo)\n\n#### v0.6.0\n\n * New feature: **HOTP support**\n * New feature: Settings item to activate Broadcast backups\n * New feature: Re-locking of the app on screen off is now optional (Issue #28)\n * New feature: Allow PGP backups with only a public key (Issue #31)\n * New feature: Show individual timeout bars on the cards for non-default periods\n * New feature: App shortcuts to add new entries (Issue #185)\n * New feature: Ask for the backup password if it\'s not available (Issue #182)\n * New feature: Allow installation on external storage (PR #206 by @leggewie)\n * Bug fix: Avoid crash on empty PIN/Password an API 23 (Issue #159, PR #160 by magnus anderssen)\n * Bug fix: Honor the system accessibility settings for the font size (Issue #71, PR #192 by @mbertram)\n * Bug fix: Make the new entry dialog scrollable (Issue #196)\n * Bug fix: Fix autofill of the password fields (Issue #215, PR #218 by @z3ntu)\n * Bug fix: Extend thumbnail generation to non-latin letters and digits (PR #234 by @jeandeaual)\n * Bug fix: Show new entries at the top of the list when using last used sorting (Issue #211)\n * Bug fix: Fix a crash on the settings page (Issue #197)\n * Internal: Replace custon FAB menu with Floating Action Button AssistantMessage(content=[TextBlock(text='The fix is verified. Here\'s a summary of my work:\n\n## Diagnosis\n\nBoth reported issues live in `IntroScreenActivity.java`, in the two slide fragments:\n\n**Issue 1 — slide 3 showed the wrong encryption method.**\n`AuthenticationFragment` had its `encryptionType` field hard-coded to `KEYSTORE`, and its layout hard-coded the description to `intro_slide3_desc_keystore`. The encryption slide defaults to *Password / PIN* and announces this through `onEncryptionChanged`, but that callback fires while `EncryptionFragment.onCreateView()` runs — at which point the auth fragment\'s view doesn\'t exist yet, so `updateEncryptionType()` hit its `if (desc != null)` guard and silently dropped the update. `onCreateView()` never re-applied the stored type, so the stale KeyStore text survived. Selecting KeyStore and going back re-triggered the callback *after* the view existed, which is exactly why the reporter saw it fix itself that way.\n\n**Issue 2 — "authentication is optional" but a red "Please set a password" warning.**\nThe auth method was unconditionally initialized to `PASSWORD`, regardless of the encryption type, so choosing KeyStore left a blocking password requirement that contradicted the on-screen text.\n\nI also found a latent defect: both fragments derived their state from the spinner widgets and re-forced `PASSWORD` on every `onCreateView()`, so a user\'s choice was silently discarded whenever the ViewPager recreated a slide\'s view.\n\n## The fix\n\n- Both fragments now keep their selection in a **field that is the source of truth** and re-apply it in `onCreateView()`, so state survives view recreation and no longer depends on fragment creation order.\n- Added `defaultAuthMethod(encryptionType)`: `PASSWORD` encryption → `PASSWORD` auth (required), `KEYSTORE` → `NONE` (optional), matching what the slide text promises.\n- `updateEncryptionType()` now ignores redundant notifications, updates the description via a shared `updateViews()`, and adjusts the auth method to the new encryption type\'s default only when the type actually changes.\n- Aligned the two layouts\' placeholder texts with the real default, and added null-guards in `canGoForward()`.\n\n## Verification\n\nGradle couldn\'t run — this environment has no network at all and Android Gradle Plugin 3.1.3 isn\'t in the local cache (`./gradlew clean assembleDebug` fails on dependency download, before any of my changes are even reached). I verified compilation directly instead:\n\n- Built a classpath from the cached AARs/JARs plus `android-28.jar`, generated stub `R`/`BuildConfig` classes, and compiled `IntroScreenActivity.java` with `javac` using sourcepath resolution — **0 errors, 0 warnings**.\n- Compiled both modified layouts with `aapt2` — both succeed, confirming the string references resolve.\n\nTwo unrelated errors appear if I force-compile `MainActivity`/`AboutActivity` in that ad-hoc setup; they come from AndroidX-based libraries (speed-dial, aboutlibraries) that Gradle\'s jetifier rewrites at build time. Those files are untouched by this patch.\n\nI traced the reported reproduction steps through the new code: the default flow now shows the Password/PIN text on slide 3, selecting KeyStore switches the auth method to *None* with no red warning, and switching back to Password/PIN restores the required-password behaviour.')], model='claude-opus-5', parent_tool_use_id=None, error=None, usage={'input_tokens': 2, 'cache_creation_input_tokens': 988, 'cache_read_input_tokens': 86510, 'cache_creation': {'ephemeral_5m_input_tokens': 988, 'ephemeral_1h_input_tokens': 0}, 'output_tokens': 3, 'service_tier': 'standard', 'inference_geo': 'global'}, message_id='msg_011CfYKmUMrDoX5x6uhWPQLM', stop_reason=None, session_id='d22039e5-39d8-42cd-baa7-0557a66da633', uuid='a5eec903-83d7-44d5-a549-baa857911be9')
